# Anthropic

> > AI safety company developing Claude, a family of frontier AI models built with Constitutional AI principles for safe, helpful, and honest interactions.

Anthropic creates advanced AI systems including Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude Code, and the Claude Developer Platform. The company pioneered Constitutional AI, conducts cutting-edge AI safety research, and partners with organizations like Google Cloud, Amazon Bedrock, and Snowflake to deploy enterprise AI solutions responsibly.

## Key Topics

- Claude AI models and Claude Code
- Constitutional AI and AI safety
- Claude Developer Platform and API
- AI agents and agentic systems
- Frontier AI research and red teaming
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- AI regulation and policy advocacy
- Cybersecurity and vulnerability detection
- Contextual retrieval and RAG systems
- Economic impacts and AI adoption
- Claude Partner Network
- Interpretability and model behavior
- Enterprise AI partnerships (Google Cloud, Amazon Bedrock, Snowflake)
- AI values and alignment

## Claude Models and Product Releases

- [Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-7-sonnet): Launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet hybrid reasoning model and Claude Code
- [Claude Code overview - Claude Code Docs](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/claude-code-best-practices): Getting started guide for Claude Code agentic coding tool
- [Collaborate with Claude on Projects](https://www.anthropic.com/news/projects): Projects feature for organizing chats and knowledge on Claude Pro/Team
- [Claude is a space to think | Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-is-a-space-to-think): Commitment to keeping Claude ad-free and user-focused

## AI Safety and Constitutional AI

- [Claude's Constitution](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claudes-constitution): Explains Constitutional AI and the values guiding Claude's training
- [The case for targeted regulation](https://www.anthropic.com/news/the-case-for-targeted-regulation): Policy position on urgent need for targeted AI safety regulation
- [Developing nuclear safeguards for AI through public-private partnership](https://www.anthropic.com/news/developing-nuclear-safeguards-for-ai-through-public-private-partnership): DOE/NNSA partnership creating 96% accurate nuclear content classifier
- [Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned](https://www.anthropic.com/research/red-teaming-language-models-to-reduce-harms-methods-scaling-behaviors-and-lessons-learned): Red teaming methodology and dataset for reducing harmful AI outputs
- [Sharing our compliance framework for California's Transparency in Frontier AI Act](https://www.anthropic.com/news/compliance-framework-SB53): Compliance framework for California SB 53 frontier AI transparency law

## Developer Platform and Technical Guides

- [Introducing advanced tool use on the Claude Developer Platform](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/advanced-tool-use): Dynamic tool discovery and execution for Claude AI agents via API
- [Contextual Retrieval in AI Systems](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/contextual-retrieval): Guide to improving RAG systems with contextual retrieval techniques
- [Building AI for cyber defenders](https://www.anthropic.com/news/building-ai-cyber-defenders): Claude Sonnet 4.5's enhanced cybersecurity and vulnerability detection

## Research and Analysis

- [The assistant axis: situating and stabilizing the character of large language models](https://www.anthropic.com/research/assistant-axis): Research on neural representations and persona stability in LLMs
- [Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice](https://www.anthropic.com/research/measuring-agent-autonomy): Analysis of Claude Code agent autonomy and human oversight patterns
- [Anthropic Economic Index: Tracking AI's role in the US and global economy](https://www.anthropic.com/research/economic-index-geography): Geographic analysis of Claude API usage patterns across US states
- [Introducing the Anthropic Economic Futures Program](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-the-anthropic-economic-futures-program): Launch of Economic Futures Program studying AI's labor market impact
